# Appendix sampling design {#sec-app-a}

## Source code

The R code we used to define the sampling frames can be found on github:
[inbo/mias-muntjac/source/sample_design/sample_frame.R](https://github.com/inbo/mias-muntjac/tree/main/source/sample_design/sample_frame.R)

The R code using the *grtsdb* R package [@onkelinx_grtsdb_2022] to draw a spatially balanced random sample can also be found on github:
[inbo/mias-muntjac/source/sample_design/grts_sample.R](https://github.com/inbo/mias-muntjac/tree/main/source/sample_design/grts_sample.R)
